parent_objective: audit M2356 repaired candidate-pack artifacts before any reset validation
blocked_by: M2356 creates repaired packs but does not run reset validation
supersedes: direct repaired-pack reset validation without audit
direct measured execution after repair materialization

public_gates: M2357 must audit M2356 repaired artifact counts and effective modification counts
M2357 must decide whether repaired packs are eligible for reset-validation design or need repair materializer changes
M2357 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim reset-valid repaired pack

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits repaired pack materialization and chooses whether to proceed to reset-validation design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no reset rerun, rollout, ranking, paper, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2356 artifacts are incomplete
stop if effective modification counts are too low for the route to remain meaningful
stop if audit routes directly to measured execution
stop if audit claims reset-valid repaired pack
fallback_plan: route to repaired-pack reset-validation design if artifacts are accepted
route to repair materializer schema fix if artifacts are incomplete
stop for user review if fallback removes too much candidate signal
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2356 materializes repaired candidate packs and requires audit before reset validation

allowed_updates: M2357 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2356 artifacts are accepted or rejected
effective modified pack counts are interpreted
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2357 audits task-quality repair artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2357; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Repair audit must not be interpreted as driver, controller, or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset-valid repaired pack, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits repaired artifacts before a new reset-validity attempt
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit repaired-pack reset-validation design if artifacts retain enough candidate signal, but cannot establish driver performance
must_synthesize_if: M2357 cannot decide whether repaired packs are reset-validation eligible
the sampling repair branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2356 repaired artifacts can decide whether the repaired packs are eligible for a separate reset-validation design.
success_criteria: effective modified pack counts are interpreted
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2357 runs reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2357 ranks support policies or controller families
M2357 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2357 claims scenario redesign executed or reset-valid repaired pack
M2357 routes directly to controller comparison

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2356 repaired artifact outputs

decision_rule: M2357 passes if it audits repaired artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
